mapping: clip(rint(2048 + 200 * physical_mV), 0, 4095); resample_poly full record then crop
purpose: engineering smoke replay; not sufficient to establish dataset-wide accuracy or independent generalization
matching: chronological reference, nearest unused detection, tie lower detection index
matched_OTHER: detector beat TP; exclude from N/V classification
unmatched_PVC: FP alarm under existing protocol; not evidence that peak is noise
physical_quality_gate: retained but synthetic ADC mapping is not an analog validity measurement
